THE RESEARCH OBJECTIVE:
Discover new mechanisms in which TRAINING-ONLY user behaviour and HYPERBOLIC geometry are computationally coupled to improve the RQ-VAE Semantic IDs used by a generative next-item recommender, with the real target of Stage3 test Recall@10 above 0.065.
THE SCOPE CONTRACT (a proposal that misses it is sent back, not scored):
A proposal is IN SCOPE only when all of this holds:
  1. BEHAVIOUR: it names one training-only behaviour signal (directed item transitions, user-interest branching, sequential co-consumption, popularity-adjusted graph neighbours, behaviour-conditioned assignment weights, ...) and says how it is computed.
  2. HYPERBOLIC GEOMETRY: it names an explicit curved operation (trainable or fixed negative curvature, Poincare or Lorentz distance, exp/log maps, geodesic scoring, curved residual, curved quantization, curved regularization) and where in training or quantization it acts.
  3. REAL COUPLING: one connected computational pathway uses both, so that removing either changes the core computation. A behaviour suffix on an unchanged Euclidean quantizer, a standalone hyperbolic loss beside an unrelated behaviour loss, a geometry name without geometric computation, or inherited unused hyperbolic code do NOT qualify.
  4. TESTABLE EFFECT: it states what should observably change (SID assignment, gradient or parameter update, prefix behaviour predictability, or Stage3 Recall) and names the behaviour-off, geometry-off/Euclidean and both-on comparisons. The three switches must be part of the mechanism, so that the coupling can be shown to be real, but the round RUNS no ablation arm: each candidate is trained once.
  5. MINIMAL SPECIFICATION: equations or pseudocode, inputs and outputs, numerical safeguards and the training cost. No proof and no paper section are required.
SID quality (ER, prefix counts, collisions) is NOT a scope criterion and NOT an admission rule.

EXPERIMENT POLICY (binding on every proposal, implementation and review):
  - ONE candidate, ONE training run, on the frozen budget (3000 Stage 2 epochs on four cards, the frozen Stage 3 protocol, no early stopping).
  - NO ablation experiments: the behaviour-off, geometry-off and both-on switches must EXIST in the code and must be correct, but no arm is trained with them switched off.
  - NO tuning experiments: no sweep over the coupling weight, the clip bound, the temperature, the usage weight or any other constant. A constant that enters the mechanism has to be DERIVED (a scale-relative bound, a measured quantity, a documented default), not chosen by trying values.
  - NO multi-seed experiments: a candidate is not repeated with other seeds, so a single run decides it and the seed noise is part of the uncertainty.
  - The behavioural diagnostics (coherence, adjacency, transfer predictability) are recorded, never used as an admission gate; Stage 3 test_recall@10 is the judgement.
  - A proposal that needs an ablation, a sweep or a seed repetition to make its case is out of programme: it has to make the case with one run.
Explore materially different coupling positions, for example: behaviour-weighted curved assignment or Sinkhorn; behaviour hierarchy in a negatively curved latent or quantizer; behaviour-directed curved residual or transition optimization. These are examples, not a fixed list.

The round objective: Discover new mechanisms in which TRAINING-ONLY user behaviour and HYPERBOLIC geometry are computationally coupled to improve the RQ-VAE Semantic IDs used by a generative next-item recommender, with the real target of Stage3 test Recall@10 above 0.065.

Round three. One mechanism along the chain: user behaviour data -> behaviour graph -> tree-structure check -> behaviour item embedding -> Gromov delta -> hyperbolic curvature -> text embedding into a hyperbolic RQ-VAE -> behaviour supervision -> SID -> Stage3 -> test_recall@10. Target: a real test_recall@10 above 0.065 from one frozen four-GPU Stage2 run and one frozen Stage3 run. The baseline is the round-two mechanism tree TIGER_CONCMID-GEO-SID.

WHAT ROUNDS ONE AND TWO MEASURED (all with the frozen chain: Stage2 3000 epochs at 0.145-0.16 s per epoch, Stage3 150 epochs, full protocol):
Round one, a curved residual chain on the frozen text geometry: L1/L2/L3 prefixes 251/1769/2201, test_recall@10 = 0.05439, recall@5 = 0.0360, ndcg@10 = 0.0296.
Round two, a concentration-scaled geodesic step moving each item toward its popularity-adjusted successor barycentre (99.1% of the items moved, median displacement 0.0207): prefixes 230/1251/1298, test_recall@10 = 0.05165, recall@5 = 0.0350, ndcg@10 = 0.0283.
The gate is 0.065; the frozen baseline's own number is about 0.0679. Both mechanisms are NEGATIVE results and both must be treated as such.

THE ONE CONSISTENT SIGNAL ACROSS THE TWO ROUNDS: the deeper prefix capacity is what separates them. Round one kept 2201 distinct L3 prefixes and scored 0.0544; round two kept 1298 and scored 0.0517. Every mechanism that MERGES prefixes has lost recall so far, and every mechanism tried so far has merged them: moving the input points toward a behaviour hub (round two) and a 3-level 256-codeword quantizer whose level three is already saturated. A mechanism that wants to move the number has to make the partition FINER at depth, or use the behaviour signal where it does not cost capacity.

CONSTRAINTS THE PROPOSALS MUST RESPECT: (a) the interaction graph is tree-like but a degree-preserving rewiring is exactly as tree-like, so 'the data is a tree' is unavailable; (b) curvature is a gauge (scaling the tangent by 1/sqrt(c) reproduces curvature 1 exactly), and on the 107 confirmed SID/recall pairs the behaviour-CONTRAST metrics predict recall (+0.7104 plain, +0.7170 Euclidean control, +0.6593 unweighted four-point) while Gromov-delta weighting and ancestor-depth weighting HURT by 0.12 and 0.075, and the radial term is group compactness rather than hierarchy; (c) any mechanism whose objective has its minimum at the ball's origin collapses the encoder (round one did exactly that twice, degenerating to one or two prefixes per level) and must be checked against that failure mode; (d) the behaviour signal must reach the TOKENS, not only the codebook positions.

WHAT IS NOW LEGITIMATELY OPEN, given the capacity evidence: the number of levels and the codebook sizes are Stage-2 hyperparameters of the frozen recipe's architecture, not its optimisation budget; a proposal that increases the deep-level capacity (for example four levels, or 512 codewords at levels two and three) is a candidate mechanism in its own right IF it is coupled with a train-only behaviour signal and an explicit curve operation in one connected computational path, and if the total parameter count and the per-step cost stay within the measured Stage-2 budget (about 0.15 s per epoch on four GPUs).

HARD CONSTRAINTS: one formal training run per candidate (3000 epochs, four-GPU DDP, global batch 4096), no ablation arms, no hyperparameter tuning, no seed sweeps; every constant derivable a priori. The behaviour-off / geometry-off / both-on switches must exist in the code and be wired correctly, but only the both-on arm is trained. Stage3 keeps its frozen protocol. Stage2->Stage3 admission is technical validity only; test_recall@10 > 0.065 is the final judgement, and a negative result must be recorded with its numbers.
